description: Spends credits: call it only when the user agreed in chat to run the brief at its credit quote. Their message asking to generate or run it ("run the same for these") is that agreement: state the quote in the same reply, then call. Otherwise give the quote and wait for their yes; a request to change the brief is not one. Pass brief.revision and brief.quote.total_credits of your last propose_brief, update_brief or get_brief result as expected_brief_revision and expected_total_credits, and idempotency_key brief-{brief_id}-r{revision} (a retry with the same key never runs or charges twice). On quote_changed, tell the user the new quote and wait for their yes. Then follow it with mcp_brief_runs.

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

expected_brief_revision.description: The board's brief_revision shown with this brief.

expected_total_credits.description: The quote's total_credits the user saw.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key for one Generate: the same key never runs or charges twice.
